reason: A portable, local Markdown memory protocol for AI agents that combines a bounded always-loaded index, curation rules, validation, and an optional edit hook.

summaries.zh: 为 AI 智能体提供基于本地 Markdown 文件的可移植记忆协议，包含索引限制、记忆整理规则、验证工具和可选的编辑钩子。
summaries.en: Provides AI agents with a portable local Markdown memory protocol featuring bounded indexing, curation rules, validation tools, and an optional edit hook.

capabilities: Maintains local file-based agent memory in Markdown files
Provides a validator for memory structure and index limits
Provides standing rules for memory curation and continuity
Can use a PreToolUse hook to block over-cap growth for matched direct-edit tools
